question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is Express.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider meaning of each option-

 
 
• Depress- Make (someone) feel utterly dispirited or dejected.
 
• Express- Convey (a thought or feeling) in words or by gestures and conduct. 
 
• Repress- Subdue (someone or something) by force.
 
• Impress- Make (someone) feel admiration and respect.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per point mentioned, that 'express' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: It is impossible to express oneself without using words.
